text:
cassie_cs: Heads-up: VellumHealth has a partner demo in APAC tomorrow 09:30 SGT. They experienced rate throttles last week. Request: temporary APAC egress allowlist + short burst capacity (~600 QPS) for 5h. Must preserve X-Vellum-Session header. Who can own execution & rollback?

nathan_netops: Please paste CIDRs and exact UTC window. Also confirm whether this is edge allowlist + header passthrough.

cassie_cs: CIDRs (redacted): 198.51.100.12/32, 203.0.113.200/30. Window: 2026-05-10 01:00 -> 06:00 UTC (09:00 -> 14:00 SGT). Edge allowlist + header passthrough required. Project: vellum-prod. Renewal flag: they said demo success influences pilot -> paid conversion.

ishaan_eng: I can create an ephemeral policy. Plan: create apac-scoped allowlist with conservative steady QPS (80) and burst 600, tag it for billing, set expiry at 06:00 UTC with auto-revoke. Canary to apac-edge-1 for 10m then global. Add an alert to #eng-sre for 429s > 0.5%.

maria_ops: +1 to tagging. Please add tag = pilot-vellum so finance can pick up. Also, capture token delta and put a short note in account_health sheet after demo.

ishaan_eng: CLI snippet to run from infra bastion:

```
redwoodctl policies create \
  --name vellum-apac-demo-2026-05-10 \
  --project vellum-prod \
  --region apac \
  --cidrs 198.51.100.12/32,203.0.113.200/30 \
  --header-forward X-Vellum-Session \
  --qps 80 --burst 600 \
  --expires 2026-05-10T06:00:00Z \
  --tags pilot-vellum,trial,billing
```

ishaan_eng: I'll apply to apac-edge-1 in canary then roll. Will post monitoring link.

policy-bot: policy vellum-apac-demo created (edge-policy-7788) in apac-edge-1 (canary).

nathan_netops: Firewall + proxy passthrough configured on apac-proxy-02. Run a quick smoke curl to validate header preservation:

```
curl -I -H "X-Vellum-Session: smoke-001" https://apac-edge-01.redwood-inference.example/vellum/health
```

cassie_cs: running smoke now  will report back in 3m.

cassie_cs: smoke returned 200 OK, header echoed, no 429s in first 7m. Demo lead confirmed audio flow ok.

maria_ops: billing tag added. Short Grafana panel + 429 alert wired to #eng-sre. Auto-revoke scheduled.

policy-bot: canary rolled to apac-edge-2/3. policy edge-policy-7788 now active across APAC.

ishaan_eng: leaving extended monitoring for 2h post-demo. Plan to reduce burst to 100 and steady qps to 20 two hours after demo, before expiry.

policy-bot: policy edge-policy-7788 auto-revoked at 2026-05-10T06:00:03Z (expiry reached).

cassie_cs: demo success reported by customer. Logging pilot metrics and customer feedback in account_health sheet. We'll propose a steady-state quota uplift and include token-cost estimate + prefix-caching recommendation in renewal discussion. Thanks all! :tada:
